name: Moonlight Desires
source:
Commander Nathalian Bloodmoon and his soldiers are in the middle of a war. What he wasn't expecting was the future battle he was about to face against his feelings and desires! 

Between his long-time combat partner and his newly met human enemy, Nathalian has to decide what his vampiric heart should follow...

[From [url=https://cyberburd.itch.io/moonlight-desires]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
指挥官纳萨利安·血月和他的士兵正处于战争之中。让他没想到的是，未来他将面临与感情和欲望的战斗！

在他的长期战斗伙伴和新遇到的人类敌人之间，纳萨利安必须决定他的吸血鬼之心应该遵循什么……

[来自[url=https://cyberburd.itch.io/moonlight-desires]Itch.io[/url]]
